title: Space Demolition trait evidence and controlled observation

provenance.location: TOPICPOS 1770601 (0x001b0469), HLP file offset 447070 (0x0006d25e), topic 263 'Space Demolition'
provenance.note: Decoded help topic for Space Demolition; documented-only claim, not a runtime observation.

provenance.location: dialog #149 resource at file offset 0x2fa900, control 276, caption 'Space Demolition'; style 0x50000009 (BS_AUTORADIOBUTTON)
provenance.note: Executable location of the trait name/control is a lead; it does not prove runtime mechanics.

setup.baseline: A custom race with no other selected trait and otherwise identical wizard choices.
setup.variable: Select only Space Demolition and record the advantage-point balance and observable effects.
setup.universe: Single-player, fixed small universe with one Turindrones opponent if the runtime exposes it (otherwise record the actual opponent), fixed difficulty, no random events; keep the same seed/settings across trials.

procedure: Create the baseline race and record the step 1-6 settings and advantage-point balance.
Create the same race with only Space Demolition changed; record the exact advantage-point balance and any disabled controls.
Start the game and record starting technology, planets, fleets, installations and available catalog entries.
Run a controlled comparison for each documented effect, varying one input at a time and repeating at least three trials where randomness may apply.
Record the observed result, game year, settings and any discrepancy from the documented claim.

documented: Starts with Propulsion and Biotech tech 2, one scout, one colony ship and two mine layers (documented-only).
Exclusive mine dispenser, hull and Energy Dampener entries are documented (documented-only).
Minefields act as non-penetrating scanners for this race, and cloaks act as an absolute percentage against mine scans (documented-only).
Travels through opponent minefields at two warp speeds faster, can remotely detonate standard minefields, and learns exact designs of ships that detonate its mines (documented-only).
Own minefields decay at 1% per enclosed planet per year; other players' fields decay at 4% (documented-only).

unresolved: Detonation radius, damage and timing are unknown.
Decay ordering and the 50% cap interaction are unknown.
Mine-scan range and cloak formula are unknown.
notes: The help is dated January 1998 and its applicability to stars26i.exe is unverified. No original-game execution is claimed by PR2.
